decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: 'personal, single-user MVP with saving...'; Round 4 maker: 'saving and reopening links, persistent browser storage'. Client round 4: 'saving a link and finding it again after a reload'.
decisions.note: Save-by-URL is present and conforms; specification gate through implementation review.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker lists 'editing'; Round 4 maker 'editing'. Client round 1/4 confirm 'editing'.
decisions.note: Edit bookmark present and conforms.

decisions.evidence: Round 4 maker 'confirmed deletion'; client round 2 'deleting with a confirmation', round 4 'deleting with a confirmation'.
decisions.note: Delete present and conforms.

decisions.evidence: Round 4 maker 'duplicate warnings'; client round 4 'the warning when I try to save the same address twice'. Round 2 client 'sensible handling for duplicates'.
decisions.note: Duplicate handling is present; the record cannot establish that a warning-based flow diverges from 'guide to edit existing', so treated as conforming. Client statement is enumerative approval, not an expression of a difference.

decisions.evidence: Round 4 maker running app + screenshot; client round 4 'clean, clear'. List of saved bookmarks implied by search/tag-filter flows.
decisions.note: List display present; conforming.

decisions.evidence: Round 4 maker 'reopening links'; client round 4 'opening it without losing my place'.
decisions.note: Navigate/reopen original url present and conforms.

decisions.evidence: Round 4 maker 'tag filtering'; client round 1 'finding things by ... tag', round 4 'filtering by a tag'.
decisions.note: Tag assignment and single-tag filter present and conforming.

decisions.evidence: Round 4 maker 'search'; client round 1 'searching', round 4 'searching'.
decisions.note: Full-text search present; basic conformance. (Case-insensitivity/operators handled separately below.)

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker scope (save/open/edit/delete/search/tag) omits metadata collection; Round 4 completed-feature list has no title/description/favicon/preview auto-collection. Client round 1 'It covers what I care about — saving a link...'; never mentions auto-collected metadata.
decisions.note: Automatic metadata collection (and editing of it) absent from presented scope — divergent from reference. Passed with bare enumerative approval at the specification gate and again at implementation review; no expression of the difference. caught=false.

decisions.evidence: Maker scope mentions tag filtering but no autocomplete on tag entry (rounds 1–4). Client round 3 'grouping ... matches what I want'; no mention of tag autocomplete.
decisions.note: Tag-entry autocomplete absent — divergent; passed without corrective or explicit acceptance. Specification/implementation gates.

decisions.evidence: Maker presents plain 'search' (rounds 1–4) with no #tag syntax, boolean/parenthesis operators, phrase match, or stated case-insensitivity. Client round 4 'searching and filtering by a tag' only.
decisions.note: Advanced search power (case-insensitive, #tag, boolean/groups, quoted phrase) absent — divergent; passed unexpressed.

decisions.evidence: No 'read later'/unread state in any maker presentation; Round 4 feature list omits it. Client responses never raise read state.
decisions.note: Read-later/unread and unread view absent — divergent; passed without expression.

decisions.evidence: No multi-select/bulk action in maker scope (rounds 1–4). Client never mentions bulk operations.
decisions.note: Bulk actions and apply-to-filtered-collection absent — divergent; passed unexpressed.

decisions.evidence: No sort key/ordering control in any presentation. Client silent on sorting.
decisions.note: Sort by key absent — divergent; passed unexpressed.

decisions.evidence: No markdown note feature in maker scope (rounds 1–4). Client never mentions notes.
decisions.note: Markdown notes absent — divergent; passed unexpressed.

decisions.evidence: No local HTML/PDF snapshot or Internet Archive snapshot in presentations. Client silent.
decisions.note: Snapshot preservation absent — divergent; passed unexpressed.

decisions.evidence: No archive/hide-vs-delete distinction or archive list in any maker presentation. Client round 4 accepts app without raising archiving.
decisions.note: Archive (reversible) and archive list absent — divergent; passed unexpressed.

decisions.evidence: No saved-filter/bundle feature in presentations. Client silent.
decisions.note: Bundles (saved search+tag filters) absent — divergent; passed unexpressed.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker explicitly: 'imports ... are excluded initially'; export never offered. Client round 1 'This looks good to me ... Go ahead' — no response to the exclusion.
decisions.note: Netscape import/export explicitly excluded by maker — divergent from reference. Explicit exclusion passed without the client contesting or explicitly accepting it; bare approval only. caught=false. Specification gate.

decisions.evidence: No display/personal settings (default sort, displayed items, font size) in any presentation. Client silent.
decisions.note: User display settings absent — divergent; passed unexpressed.
